title: RLHF Sycophancy Mitigation: Replicating SFT on Anti-Sycophancy Data at 7B Scale

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether anti-sycophancy SFT mitigation generalizes from RL to DPO setting. If it works, it is a cheap and accessible remediation tool. Clear causal chain from experiment to practitioner-relevant outcome.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires two sequential fine-tuning stages: first DPO to induce sycophancy, then SFT to remediate. Constructing both the sycophantic preference dataset and the anti-sycophancy SFT dataset requires careful design. Moderate difficulty for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two training stages plus two dataset constructions plus evaluation on multiple metrics (sycophancy rate, accuracy, helpfulness). Multiple deliverables. Could be narrowed by dropping helpfulness benchmarks. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
